title: NekoTech
description: This is a lightweight tech Mod themed around cats.
body:
# Welcome to NekoTech!

![Title of Nekotech](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37ad48d93d962bb840d137b72a6d1dfc55693888.jpeg)

## Introduction
This is a lightweight technology mod with a cat theme. 

**Please note that NekoTech is still in the alpha testing phase, and the content may not be fully complete. We appreciate your anticipation.**

If you're tired of boring logistics and dull production lines in typical tech mods, maybe it's time to add some cute cats to your factory. After all, who wouldn't want a bunch of adorable kitties running around and working for you? Or better yet, why not build an entire tech tree around cats?

## What's inside?
**Materials**: New crops like catnip and cat grass, ores such as tin, plus several new alloys.

**Machines**: Some machines, most of which need cats to actually work.

**Tools**: A mix of production tools and little cat-toy gadgets for playing with your furry workers.

The mod adds various cat-related materials, items, and machines. Power generation, logistics, and processing all rely on your feline friends. The style stays close to vanilla Minecraft – you unlock better materials by gradually upgrading your furnace temperature, which then leads to better equipment and fun cat-themed gadgets.

## How to start:
- Dig underground for tin and aluminum – they spawn like other ores. Smelt them into ingots, then toss them into the Alloy Pot with other stuff to make better and better alloys.
 
- Build Workbench and Hammer so you can make Metal Plates, which are one of the basic ingredients you'll need for almost everything in this mod.
  
- To get your first feline workers, craft a Cat Box and trap a wild cat. Feed it to tame it, and it'll start dropping Cat Fur and other goodies – plus it'll actually help you run machines!
- Plant some Cat Grass and Catnip – you'll need them to make component casings. Then craft different machine parts and slot them into your machines so they can actually run.


## Features:
- A lightweight technology mod with a cat theme.
- A New logistics method with cats.
- Low-performance power system.
- Vanilla style models. 
- A lovely gaming experience with cats～

## Installation Requirements
The version of Nekotech runs with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) on Fabric loader.

Moreover, you can add the [Patchouli](https://modrinth.com/mod/patchouli) to look at our tutorial, which is really useful.

**Install these before adding Nekotech to your game.**
